title: Rescue from Fort Kastav
description: Legate Rikke orders the player to infiltrate Stormcloak-held Fort Kastav, free imprisoned Legionnaires, and retake the fort with Hadvar's scout team.

base_facts: I command Imperial operations from the Winterhold Imperial Camp.
I assign missions to reclaim holds from the Stormcloaks.

MISSION_BRIEFING: I sent the soldier to take Fort Kastav and free our imprisoned Legionnaires.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Fort Kastav has been retaken and our prisoners rescued.

base_facts: I lead a scout team operating near Stormcloak-held forts.
I prefer to infiltrate forts through side entrances before launching a full assault.

SCOUTS_AND_INFILTRATE: I briefed the soldier on the plan to sneak into Fort Kastav through the grate and free the prisoners.
FREE_PRISONERS: The prisoners have been freed and are ready to fight.
TAKE_FORT: The fort is ours. I will remain here to garrison it.
REPORT_HADVAR: I told the soldier to report our success to General Tullius.

beats.comment: Player reports to Rikke at Winterhold Imperial Camp and accepts the mission.
Player meets Hadvar's scouts near Fort Kastav and begins sneaking in through the grate.
Player frees the Imperial prisoners from their cells inside the fort.
Player clears Fort Kastav of Stormcloak soldiers with the freed prisoners and scouts.
Player reports back to Hadvar after the fort is taken; he says he will garrison it.
Quest completes; player is directed to report to General Tullius under Reunification of Skyrim.
